content: TRAP2 TdTomato/Fos colocalization in QuPath: The core challenge is that TdTomato is cytosolic while DAPI detection anchors to nuclei, requiring a cytoplasmic expansion ring to measure TdTomato in the correct compartment. Forum thread (image.sc Dec 2025) documents that misalignment between DAPI nuclear detection and cytosolic TdTomato signal leads to overcounting. The bioRxiv 2024.09.16.611953 preprint (Cabrera et al.) describes an optimized TRAP2 pipeline using QuPath+ABBA that benchmarks detection parameters specifically for this biology.
